resources.string: Labels
Open label reader. Scans barcodes and reads labels word for word.

string.name: labels_help
string.description: Spoken list of what can be said in this tool

resources.string: Hold up a packet, tin or box. You can say: scan this, look it up, read the label, read it all, when does it expire, ingredients, cooking instructions, allergens, does it contain nuts, what is it, stop, or close. Only the barcode number goes online, and only when you say look it up.
Looking for a barcode. Hold it up and turn it slowly.
Turn it slowly. Barcodes are usually on the back or bottom.
I can see a barcode. Bring it a little closer and hold it steady.
I can see a barcode. Hold it steady.
I couldn\'t find a barcode. I\'ll read the label instead.
Found a barcode. Say look it up to get the product name, or read the label.
Found a barcode, but it isn\'t a product barcode. It reads %1$s. Say read the label to hear the text.
Say read the label to hear the text around it.
Stopped. Say scan this to look again.
I haven\'t found a barcode yet. Say scan this to look for one, or read the label.
I\'m still looking for a barcode. Turn it slowly, or say read the label.
That isn\'t a product barcode, so I can\'t look it up. Say read the label.
Looking it up.
Say allergens or ingredients for more, or read the label.
Open Food Facts doesn\'t know this product. Say read the label, and I\'ll read it to you.
I can\'t reach the internet, so I can\'t look it up. Say read the label, and I\'ll read it to you.
The product lookup didn\'t work just now. Say look it up to try again, or read the label.
From Open Food Facts, the ingredients are: %1$s
Reading the label.
I couldn\'t get a picture from the glasses. Say read the label to try again.
I can\'t read any writing. Hold it about a hand\'s length from your face, keep it steady, and say read the label again.
The writing is too small. Bring it closer and say read the label again.
Sorry, reading the label failed. Say read the label to try again.
Something is covering the camera. Check the glasses, then say read the label.
It\'s too dark to read. Turn on a light, then say read the label.
I can\'t see a label. Hold it in front of you, about a hand\'s length away.
There\'s glare on the label. Tilt it away from the light a little, then say read the label.
Part of the label is covered, maybe by your hand. Hold it by the edges, then say read the label.
That\'s all I can see. You can ask when does it expire, ingredients, allergens or cooking instructions.
I can\'t find a date on this side. Dates are often on the top, the bottom or the back. Turn it and ask again.
I can\'t find the ingredients on this side. Turn it slowly and ask again.
I can\'t find cooking instructions on this side. Turn it slowly and ask again.
I can\'t find allergy information on this side. Turn it and ask again, or say ingredients.
I don\'t know what it is yet. Say scan this, or read the label.
The biggest writing says: %1$s.
This looks like medicine: %1$s.
For medicine I only tell you the name and the date.
I won\'t read medicine doses. Please check with a pharmacist or a trusted person.
Medicine: %1$s. Only the name is shown. Doses are not read.
Say look it up, or read the label.
Say scan this to find a barcode, or read the label.
Ready. Say scan this.
Looking for a barcode
Barcode found
Looking up the product
Reading the label
%1$s barcode: %2$s
Scan
Look it up
Read label
Date
Allergens
